_about: Online marketplace numbers (docs/orchestration/mmo/contracts.md section 6). Fractions are rates; the engine turns them into basis points so fees are exact integers. Fees and tax round up (ceil) and never exceed the amount.
_bound_about: Contract v2 0.6: the starting wallet is bound (non-tradable). starting_wallet_bound of the starting T-stones (and every objective reward) pay sinks only (wallet.spend and listing fees, bound first), never buys, bids, buyouts or order escrow. Keep it equal to starting_wallet (tests raise starting_wallet above it to get tradable coins).
_trade_lock_about: Contract v2 0.6 / STATUS 2026-10-18 planner default (ASSUMPTION): a new account cannot list, buy, bid, buy out, post or fill orders for this many seconds after account.ensure.

settlers._about: NPC account 0. Every refresh_s it cancels its open orders and posts orders_per_refresh new ones from data/world/market.json demand, escrowing at most escrow_per_refresh. Each server day its holdings are topped up to daily_budget, so no more than daily_budget T-stones can leave Settlers per day. Price = base_price_tstones[category] x mean regional demand x scarce/abundant multiplier x price_factor.
settlers.name: Settlers

category_alias._about: items.json category -> market.json base_price_tstones category, used only when none of an item's categories is a market category itself. Items with no match are not bought by Settlers.
